mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the change in FEDFUNDS from t-3 months to t) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points and fall in employment (PAYEMS) by more than 1000 persons over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk and reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 1000 persons over the last 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high GDP growth regimes (measured by quarterly GDP growth rate > 2.0% annualized), strong economic expansion supports higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that increases recession risk and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months signals weakening economic activity that increases recession risk and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declined by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) by more than 0.5% each over the prior 3 months signals weakening demand for housing and the broader economy, increasing recession risk and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 0.5% and RSAFS falls > 0.5% over the last 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals a high-inflation environment that increases the risk of aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
